{{Top|leg}}
'''Bunker Twenty-two Aleph''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base inside the [[Revos Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. It was where the ''[[Hawkbat's Perch]]'' and ''[[Hawkbat's Vigil]]'' were serviced by [[Technicians/Legends|mechanics]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

During [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to the planet, [[Plague Group]] infiltrated the bunker disguised as mechanics; managing to booby trap both [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] with vials of [[Bunkurd Sewer Disorder]].<ref name="WS" />
